ai_requirements.text: All AI processing and model hosting must remain strictly within the EU/EEA to comply with GDPR, DORA, and Norwegian FSA regulations.
The solution must support high-quality multilingual document generation and translation across Norwegian, Swedish, Danish, and English.

use_cases.name: Multilingual Document Generation and Translation
use_cases.description: Automates the generation and translation of policy schedules, certificates, and renewal notices into multiple languages.
use_cases.retrieval_notes: Retrieve policy templates and customer-specific metadata from the Document Asset Repository (ARC_08).
use_cases.orchestration: Step-based workflow orchestration to coordinate template retrieval, translation, and generation.
use_cases.prompt_and_structured_output: System prompts defining legal terminology per language, enforcing JSON output schemas for document metadata.
use_cases.evaluation: Automated translation quality metrics and LLM-as-a-judge evaluation for compliance with regional insurance standards.
use_cases.responsible_ai_safety: Content safety filters to block offensive language and PII masking before sending data to the model.
use_cases.monitoring_feedback: Log generation latency, token usage, and user-initiated correction rates in the Central Observability Platform (ARC_09).
use_cases.human_review: Mandatory human review by regional business operators for any generated policy templates or high-value commercial schedules.
use_cases.data_privacy: Zero data retention policies on the model provider side, with all data processed strictly within EU/EEA regions.

use_cases.validation_reason: Requires customer confirmation on whether automated claims intake is desired for the self-service portal.
use_cases.name: Automated Claims Intake and FNOL Extraction
use_cases.description: Extracts structured claim details from unstructured text and documents uploaded by policyholders during First Notice of Loss.
use_cases.orchestration: Event-driven microservice orchestration triggered by self-service portal uploads.
use_cases.prompt_and_structured_output: Few-shot prompting with strict JSON schema enforcement to extract claim details (date, vehicle, incident description).
use_cases.evaluation: F1-score evaluation against a gold-standard dataset of historical claims to measure extraction accuracy.
use_cases.responsible_ai_safety: Strict input validation and safety filters to prevent prompt injection via user-submitted claim descriptions.
use_cases.monitoring_feedback: Real-time tracking of extraction confidence scores and fallback rates to manual queue.
use_cases.human_review: All extracted FNOL data must be reviewed and confirmed by the policyholder before handover to Guidewire ClaimCenter.
use_cases.data_privacy: PII scrubbing of unstructured text fields prior to model processing, ensuring compliance with GDPR.

deterministic_areas.text: Premium Rating and NCB Calculation must be deterministic to ensure exact calculations based on rating tables.
Policy Audit Trail Retention must be deterministic to guarantee immutable audit logs.
Financial premium postings to SAP S/4HANA must be deterministic to ensure financial reconciliation.

mandatory_human_decisions.text: Claims adjudication decisions must stay with human claims adjusters in Guidewire ClaimCenter.
Final approval of new insurance product configurations must be performed by business operators.

architecture_pattern: Event-driven microservices architecture with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for document assembly and structured extraction for claims intake.

provider_options.rationale: Provides enterprise-grade generative models with strong multilingual capabilities and native integration with Google Cloud's security and compliance controls.
Enables robust prompt safety, content filtering, and PII masking to comply with Norwegian FSA and GDPR requirements.
Allows hosting open-weight models within local EU/EEA infrastructure if public cloud APIs do not meet strict regulatory constraints.

framework_recommendations.validation_reason: Requires validation of the Java team's familiarity with Spring Boot and modern Java frameworks.
framework_recommendations.name: Spring AI
framework_recommendations.purpose: Orchestrate model calls, structured output generation, and document template retrieval within the Java-based backend services.
framework_recommendations.rationale: Leverages the existing Java ecosystem and skills of the Vekter team, minimizing the learning curve and accelerating integration with the core policy system.
